name: skill-scout
description: Watches the chat and suggests a new skill when a repeatable workflow could be faster

threshold.title: Starting confidence cutoff
threshold.description: Show ideas at or above this confidence (0-100) until 10 judged ideas teach it your own cutoff

minEvidence.title: Moments needed
minEvidence.description: An idea must point at least this many real moments in the conversation

minTools.title: Tool calls to trigger
minTools.description: Check after a turn with at least this many tool calls

everyTurns.title: Check every N working turns
everyTurns.description: Also check after this many turns that used tools; quiet turns never count
